title: Standing Up for a Colleague
paragraphs: Saat rapat tim, seorang manajer secara tidak adil menyalahkan rekan kerja junior atas kesalahan yang sebenarnya disebabkan oleh kesalahpahaman bersama yang melibatkan beberapa orang, bukan hanya satu orang. Rashid, yang memahami persis apa yang terjadi, angkat bicara dengan tenang untuk menjelaskan situasi secara lengkap, meski itu berarti sedikit membantah versi kejadian manajernya di depan seluruh tim.

Sejenak, suasana ruangan terasa tegang, dan Rashid mempertanyakan apakah ia mengambil keputusan yang salah, tapi manajernya berhenti sejenak, mempertimbangkan ulang faktanya, dan mengakui bahwa tanggung jawab itu memang dibagi lebih luas. Rekan kerja junior itu kemudian berterima kasih secara pribadi, lega karena ada yang bersedia meluruskan cerita. Rashid menjelaskan bahwa diam saja padahal mengetahui kebenarannya tidak akan terasa benar baginya.
answerKey: During a team meeting, one manager unfairly blames a junior colleague for a mistake that was actually caused by a shared miscommunication involving several people, not just one person. Rashid, who understands exactly what happened, speaks up calmly to explain the full situation, even though it means slightly contradicting his manager's version of events in front of the whole team. For a moment, the room feels tense, and Rashid wonders if he made the wrong decision, but the manager pauses, reconsiders the facts, and admits that the responsibility was indeed shared more broadly. The junior colleague later thanks him privately, relieved that someone was willing to correct the record. Rashid explains that staying silent when he knew the truth would not have felt right to him.
